name: M.M.LaFleur
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $189 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's workwear — dresses, suiting, knit 'Jardigan' jackets, trousers and tops, mostly $250–$550 — sold through its own website, showrooms and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2013 by Sarah LaFleur.

quote.q: Clothing was a really, really powerful way of not just getting other people to see you in that light but also you yourself.

opview: “Clothing was a really, really powerful way of not just getting other people to see you in that light but also you yourself.” — Sarah LaFleur, founder and CEO, Fortune
